step: STEP 39 — Realistic Human Character Production Infrastructure

audit.detail: Full audit of all 10 character models (player + 9 NPCs). All are procedurally generated from primitive shapes (boxes/cylinders). player.glb 43KB/~168 triangles, murugan.glb 12KB. CharacterFactory.cs, MeshOps.cs, CharacterAssetBuilder.cs generate everything from code.

asset_research.detail: Researched free realistic 3D human model sources: Mixamo (FREE with Adobe ID, 100+ characters, 1700+ animations, FBX format, Unity Humanoid compatible), Meshy AI (CC0), Cinevva (CC0). Mixamo is the primary recommendation.

production_character_builder.detail: ProductionCharacterBuilder.cs (415 lines): Editor menu 'Whispering Wilds/Characters/Build Production Characters'. Catalog of 9 characters with bilingual dialogue. Automated FBX import, Humanoid Avatar validation, prefab building with all gameplay components.

character_asset_validator.detail: CharacterAssetValidator.cs (704 lines): Editor menu 'Whispering Wilds/QA/Audit All Characters'. Validates mesh, triangles, bones, Avatar, Animator, materials, colliders, scale, gameplay components. Production gate: minimum 5,000 triangles.

integration_guide.detail: STEP_39_CHARACTER_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md (222 lines): Complete workflow from model download to runtime verification, recommended Mixamo characters, animation parameter contracts, technical requirements.

tests.detail: Step39CharacterProductionTests.cs: 18 NUnit editor tests covering ProductionCharacterBuilder, CharacterPrefabCatalog, CharacterAssetValidator, and animation parameter contracts.

character_replacement.detail: Cannot download 3D models or run Unity editor. Requires: 1) Adobe ID for Mixamo, 2) Unity 6000.6.3f1 Editor, 3) Manual FBX import and Humanoid Avatar configuration.

testResults.reason: Unity 6 editor not available in this environment
